text: Developing a successful mobile app requires careful planning from the start. One key aspect is responsive design, which ensures the app's layout and features adapt smoothly to different screen sizes, from small smartphones to large tablets. A major decision is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, offering high performance and full access to device features. Cross-platform tools allow a single codebase to work on both systems, saving time and money, though sometimes with slightly less performance. Finally, you must submit your app to official app stores, like Apple's App Store or Google Play. These stores have strict guidelines, but they provide a valuable global distribution channel for your final product.
